messages:
Sunil: Heads-up: I opened a quick signalboard thread — we're seeing inconsistent warmup coverage across routes this morning, esp /v1/stream and /v1/embeddings.
Maya: ugh, saw the alert. can you paste the panel that flagged it?
Sunil: screenshot attached to the thread (will add to dashboard later). main anomaly: warmup_coverage drops from ~78% -> 22% for several tenants around 09:12 UTC.
Jordan: is that the metric that defines coverage = requests with KV-hit within first 64 tokens? we should confirm the definition.
Sunil: yes. current metric: `warmup_coverage = sum(tokens_served_with_prefetched_kv[0:64]) / sum(tokens_total[0:64])` (30m sliding window).
Maya: that definition is fine, but sampling at 1% makes per-tenant numbers noisy. I think the incident had a tenant with low QPS and our sample produced a misleading dip.
Ava: can we show both sampled and scaled estimates in the panel? like sample_count + scaled_estimate, so SREs know uncertainty.
Jordan: agreed. also want a per-route breakdown: model, route, tenant, region. heatmap would help.
Perf-bot: profiling job started for route=/v1/stream model=rw-instruct-3b window=2026-03-18T09:00:00Z..2026-03-18T09:30:00Z
Sunil: quick PromQL sketch I used in the panel:
```
sum_over_time(prefetch.kv_warmed_tokens{route="/v1/stream"}[30m])
/ sum_over_time(request.tokens{route="/v1/stream"}[30m])
```
but we need to add `by (tenant, model, region)` and attach `sample_count`.
Maya: probably also show a small sparklines row for `token_savings` per-tenant. Ops cares about dollars saved.
Jordan: token_savings = sum(prefetch.kv_saved_tokens) * price_per_token (we already have price per token per model mapping).
Ava: two immediate ask items: 1) add uncertainty band (95% CI) when sample_count < 1000, 2) flag when warmup_coverage_delta > 40% between adjacent 5m buckets.
Sunil: noted. also want to investigate keying drift — if the prefix hashing changed last deploy it could reduce effective hits. any deploys around 09:00?
Maya: deploy-bot shows `eng-runtime@2026-03-18T08:54` rolled a KV key normalization change. tagging Jordan.
Jordan: that aligns. I ran a tiny offline simulation: normalizing whitespace changed ~2.3% of keys but caused a cascade for some tenant templates that had templated prefixes -> full miss.
Perf-bot: extracted example mismatch:
```
expected_key: "user:123:prompt:Hello"
normalized_key: "user:123:prompt:Hello\n"
```
Sunil: ok that explains it. for dashboards, let's add a small panel that counts `normalized_mismatch_rate` by tenant.
Maya: also we should add a rollout filter: show warmup coverage pre/post deploy window automatically when a deployment is detected.
Jordan: actionables: a) dashboard panels to implement (coverage with CI, sparklines, scaled estimates, mismatch_rate), b) add an automated annotation when a deploy occurs, c) temp rollback or targeted key-compat shim for impacted tenants.
Ava: I'll file a short P0 with the SRE runbook and link this thread. tagging @oncall.
Sunil: thanks. I'll add the panel defs and a PromQL variant for the scaled estimate. pulling the perf-bot profiling artifacts now.
Maya: one more: for low-QPS tenants, present a per-day rolling average instead of instant 30m to avoid false-positive paging.
Jordan: good call. I'll prototype the heatmap with a min-sample threshold and a tooltip explaining the sampling correction.
Perf-bot: profiling job completed. artifacts: s3://redwood-profiling/2026-03-18/1924683450.tar.gz
Sunil: perfect. meeting in 30 to review dashboard PR and decide on rollback threshold. :thumbsup:
Maya: see you then. :coffee:
Ava: added runbook link in the thread. I'll also add the affected tenant list from the profiling output.
Jordan: leaving notes in the PR. thanks everyone.
